winner_reason: B follows the Another Lens method as published, delivers an owned, testable spec, and marks assumptions honestly, whereas A invents its own lenses and states unsourced statistics as fact.
A applies Another Lens as published and converts findings into a measurable, owned spec with honest handling of unknowns; B is a long, idea-rich but unstructured exploration.
B applies the method as published, delivers testable, owned design changes, and marks its numbers and assumptions honestly; A is richer in narrative but long, unsourced in places and not actionable.
B delivers the timed facilitation script the user needs and handles the BD lead gracefully; A is more faithful and honest but thin on the meeting itself.
A applies a card-pairing structure faithfully and marks assumptions; B's method looks fabricated and its legal assertions are overconfident.
A applies the Anti-Hero cards faithfully, stays concise, and labels invented content; B is more elaborate but drifts from the method and repeats itself.
A applies all 12 canvas cells with severity, systemic classification, and honest assumptions; B ignores the canvas and invents details about the product.
A applies the actual 12-cell Bad Design Canvas with severity ratings, a statement and a build verdict; B offers good detail but substitutes its own framework.
B completes the twelve-cell canvas, prioritises findings and gives a conditional verdict with assumptions logged; A is an unstructured harm list.
B gives a broader failure-mode inventory and eight traceable anti-goals with audit tests the design lead can bring to the review, plus a ledger, whereas A offers only three untested anti-goals.
B gives falsifiable anti-goals with tests and brief traces, matching the request to skip full episodes; A supplies narrative scenarios that a team cannot directly test against.
A ties episodes to testable, traceable anti-goals and stays closer to the app's real mechanics; B is broader but generic and less usable in a design review.
A runs the CIDER cycle with concrete scenarios and redesigns; B is a broader but method-agnostic exclusion list.
B applies the staged method with clearly labelled illustrative scenarios and unknowns, while A substitutes a generic audit outline and asserts invented details of the current system as fact.

Task asks for CIDER specifically; B applies the staged method faithfully and gives actionable commitment and ledger, while A substitutes a generic audit frame. Scores are close because A covers all four groups better.
A applies the method's actual structure and is more specific and honest about assumptions; B is generic and includes an invented prior-conversation reference.
B applies the actual method with sequenced protocols, non-leading questions and halt rules, and marks unknowns; A is a generic script that assumes its findings.

B applies the Critical Interviewing structure (indirect openers, back-up and emergency questions, probe types, covert categories) and adds safeguards; A relies on direct probing questions and a generic interview arc.
B applies the method as published and ends with a concrete, ship-ready change; A is a looser generic critique. B's invented session reactions cost it on honesty but not enough to flip the result.

A runs the DAH Cards artifacts faithfully (black/white pairs, consequence map, sorting verdict, honest microcopy) and gives a direct ship decision with honest assumptions; B substitutes generic principles.
B applies the DAH Cards artifacts and openly labels its assumptions, while A invents the product, participants, quotes and data practices as fact.
A applies the Compass's actual heuristics and marks unknowns; B invents session events and a different process.
A applies the Digital Ethics Compass categories faithfully, names unknowns, assigns owners and priorities, and attends closely to affected people; B is a generic responsible-AI analysis.
B follows the named method fully, gives prioritised actions tied to business pressure, and records assumptions in a ledger; A is a strong but off-method critique with invented retention figures.
A gives measurable commitments with named owners, breach triggers, harm audit and an evidence ledger; B stays at generic best-practice level.
B builds accountability into the contract through owners, breach triggers, red lines and a ledger of assumed thresholds, which fits the organisation-duty brief better than A's general policy list.
A gives owned, checkable commitments and separates assumptions from facts; B covers the topics well but is more generic and presents numbers without caveats.

B performs the ethicography structure (moves, quadrants, performative ethics, affected populations) with reconstruction labels and verification records; A is honest but only a generic lifecycle post-mortem. B's invented specifics narrow the margin.
A reconstructs and labels what it cannot know and applies the method; B presents invented incidents and commitments as the company's real history.

Both are strong, but A builds its trace on invented actors, decisions and confirming documents presented as sources, which would mislead the team; B reasons from the given facts and labels its illustrations.
A is more faithful to the method, more specific and actionable, and marks assumptions in a ledger; B's reject button is better design but its analysis is thinner.
A applies the method with concrete redesigns, harm analysis and an owned, measurable plan, outweighing its invented root causes; B is accurate in tone but generic and thin.

A covers all dark patterns, maps them to countermeasures, gives prioritized owned fixes with metrics, and analyses vulnerable users; B is a single-pattern narrative without measurement or legal context.
B applies the method fully, identifies compounding stacks and offers tiered alternatives with business tension; A is a generic per-mechanic critique.
A applies the guide's actual sensitivities and worksheet structure with specific mechanisms and honest evidence marking; B invents lenses.
A applies the Humane Design Guide's required components with specific mechanisms, tiered alternatives, compound harms and a ledger; B is a competent but generic teen-safety review.
B applies the Inverted Behavior Model's actual steps with concrete mechanisms, vulnerable-group analysis and flagged assumptions; A replaces the method with a generic critique.

A applies the full Inverted Behavior Model with stakeholders, inversion, convergence, cascades, rationalisation checks, actionable redesigns and an explicit evidence ledger; B is a generic risk essay with weak method fidelity.
B applies the Inverted Behavior Model's actual sequence and rationalizations check and labels its assumptions in a ledger, while A is useful but a looser generic inversion.
B applies the Motivation Matrix as designed with contexts, rated cells and cell-traced redesigns plus a ledger; A produces a generic feature-by-motivation essay.
B builds the actual motivation-by-context grid with vulnerable groups and a ledger of assumptions; A is a generic audit with unflagged guesses.
A fills the Motivation Matrix as the method requires, labels its assumed contexts and facts, and links findings to redesigns; B restructures around mechanics and asserts unsourced facts.
B applies a fuller named-lens method, marks assumptions and unknowns, and handles unresolved conflicts; A states unknown facts about the platform as findings.
B applies the full method including creator impact, per-factor tests and a conflict matrix, and ends with a testable plan and sourced ledger; A is a competent but generic three-lens essay.
B applies the Normative Design Scheme's actual components and gives concrete alternatives with a ledger; A is a sound but generic three-framework essay.
A applies Pledge Works with owners, breach consequences and traceability that make the commitment enforceable; B is a generic accessibility process document.
B applies the full pledge method with owners, signals and consequences and a ledger of assumptions; A is a clean but unaccountable template with invented context.
B applies the Pledge Works components with owners and consequences and flags thresholds as proposed, whereas A fabricates audit findings and follows a generic template.
A applies the actual Prism structure and flags what the brief leaves unknown, whereas B invents a lens framework and states unverified details as facts.
B applies the Prism's axes, mechanism audit and redesign pathways with deeper ethical attention, outweighing A's cleaner per-element layout built on an invented framework.
A applies the Prism axes and gives a placement backed by evidence and a ledger; B invents its own framework, asserts unsourced facts and its 6.5/10 score contradicts its lens scores.

A runs each toolkit stage as published, covers both options in depth, and discloses assumptions in a ledger; B is shorter but substitutes its own scoring scheme and presents invented statistics unmarked.

A applies the Weighing Options structure fully, with specific, actionable content; its fabricated context is a real honesty flaw but B's gaps in method fidelity, coverage and actionability outweigh B's honesty advantage.
B applies the Frame and Gauge faithfully with honest evidence handling; A fabricates survey statistics and misapplies the Gauge.
B applies the method's actual steps with clear classifications, safeguards and honest assumptions; A is a generic option comparison that departs from the method.

B follows the Value Dams and Flows method more faithfully (strength, intensity, power to unblock, negotiation, balance statement), gives an actionable agenda, and labels assumptions in a ledger; A is a generic value-conflict analysis.
A applies the method's dam/flow typology, strength and unblocking power at feature level and flags assumptions; B stays at stakeholder-pair generalities.
B applies the real Values Levers method within the designer's actual authority and keeps to what is known; A invents statistics and omits the method.

A uses the method's actual levers with a resistance map and a staged 30-day plan fitted to a new manager without authority; B swaps in its own lever categories and fabricates adoption by named companies and a results figure.
B applies the actual lever set with owners, a facilitation plan and a ledger; A substitutes levers and fabricates user quotes.
B carries worries through clustering to objectives, constraints and test questions and has an evidence ledger, while A stops at a generic risk list.
A is more complete, actionable and honest, with an evidence ledger and mitigations; B invents session details and stops at worries.
B is cleaner and more complete and specific; A's leaked scratch work and broken cross-references outweigh its closer method steps.
